notes.title: Create keyboards
notes.content:
In Devices Tycoon you will have the opportunity to create your own keyboards. The editor offers you a variable design of the case and each key of the keyboard!

Keyboard design
We have created an editor in which you can create a very variable keyboard design. You can choose the style of each key from templates or create a key design yourself.

You will also have the opportunity to edit the design of the case, switches and even the connector.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990074/632fd3a7b57c20a64d6abbcb355b5f958415d3ee.png"]
Switches
One of the most important parts of a keyboard is, of course, the switches. We have added hundreds of switches to choose from with unique designs and unique characteristics. Do you want to make a gaming keyboard, an everyday one or an office one? No problem!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990074/696ad35117f4f503dde9b9c02c5b4eb44a4a4db4.png"]
Additional functions
A wide variety of additional functions awaits you, such as creating macros, night mode, adaptive backlighting and much more!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990074/c11f15f23291f0ed49387bc6150d4bb77405e637.png"]
Keyboard package
You can also please your future buyers and add a keyboard mat, key clips or a dust brush to the package.

You can also edit the design of the keyboard pad yourself: choose the color, static backlight and RGB backlight, or add an exclusive design to the pad.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990074/c2068430acfa7f2e13e5858fa8b597b086141445.png"]

Thank you for adding the game to the wishlist, we really appreciate it!

notes.title: Create a VR/XR/MR headsets
notes.content:
Virtual reality is more popular than ever at the moment, so we couldn't ignore technological progress and added virtual reality glasses to Devices Tycoon.
The virtual reality glasses editor will be rich, like other device editors in our game! Of course, you will be able to edit both the design and technical characteristics and additional functions for your headset. You can make both a gaming VR headset (for example, Meta Quest) and for everyday use (for example, Apple Vision Pro), it all depends on your choice.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990074/083a870dab5c6bdc811a89666dc604343e216772.png"]
VR headset design
You can choose one of many headset cases and additional design elements, which will make your headset absolutely unique.

Case design, backlighting, gradients, logos and much more are one of the key details to the success of your VR glasses sales.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990074/f276c66e9bc46a7419870a628f02d3ab44876cbe.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990074/8f5165754ed986969b3fb3be8b4d4db8abe9e870.png"]
Technical characteristics
The choice of technical characteristics is no less important for the success of your future company. CPU, GPU, RAM and RAM type, built-in memory, refresh rate and memory speed - all this and more awaits you in the editor. Remember about the balance between technical characteristics, price and weight of the headset!

Since the VR headset is a portable device, the choice of technical details will also affect the weight of your headset!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990074/7f6028242da2175db4b92defdb1d74ee84119fb6.png"]
Cameras
One of the most important things in a VR headset is the cameras. You will edit the quality, quantity, angles and radii of the cameras yourself. For more detailed display or tracking of user movements, you will need multiple cameras, which have high system requirements.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990074/b9789fe54eb31741c0162177599e46ea25acd854.png"]
Additional headset
You can add controllers and headphones to the sales kit. This may cost extra money, but your future buyers will definitely appreciate this addition.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990074/261890194955a46b420a3cd12a9dc31bcd6e58ea.png"]
Thank you for adding Devices Tycoon to your wishlist, it means a lot to us!

notes.title: Create consoles and gamepads
notes.content:
We are back to the Devices Tycoon (PC) news feed!
Today we want to introduce you to the game console and gamepad editor. In the game editor, you can create not only your own design, but also many system characteristics.

Console and gamepad design
You can create your own design of the console and gamepad of your dreams. You can choose one of many cases, color, backlight, logos, color gradients and much more.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990074/8886c4a256c30091f7003cf091fe2b70930fa84f.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990074/52511bca7190b4bc1c3cc1a1a9efc47bc2397a87.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990074/558364256831574adbed457d2883bf6ba6d2bc35.png"]
Technical characteristics
The editor will also have access to many technical characteristics for your devices. You can choose the CPU and GPU, processor frequency, number of cores, threads, bit depth, video memory, RAM, RAM type, ROM, ROM type and speed, and much more.

You will have to carefully select the characteristics for the console, because more demanding consoles require improved cooling. Of course, you can choose the type and level of cooling yourself. The higher the cooling level, the higher the cost of the console. Therefore, you will need to carefully select the parts for the console to create a balance between cost and technical characteristics.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990074/7f6028242da2175db4b92defdb1d74ee84119fb6.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990074/a91499ee82d152fe386fbb38280b3f95178f500c.png"]
Additional functions
You will have access to hundreds of additional functions in the editor. Adding each function will require additional costs for the technical characteristics of your console or gamepad, because each additional function has its own minimum system requirements.

Additional functions will include: supported graphics, peripherals, screen resolution and technology, online functions, game assistants, protection system and much more.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990074/a77207b6d373b7559221ddef36309f31c234f631.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990074/561e95a9dff162af7507c252a48aa1c069d75896.png"]

Thank you for adding our game to your wishlist, we really appreciate it!
